description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Mr. Viren Ruberu has been appointed as the employers' Representatives member the Wages Board for Rubber Cultivation and Raw Rubber Processing Trade appointment Valid Only upto 01.01.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the appointment of a specific individual (Mr. Viren Ruberu) to a government board (Wages Board for the Rubber Cultivation and Raw Rubber Processing Trade). It names the person and provides a basic title ("Employers’ Representatives member") but does not include any detailed description of his portfolio responsibilities or duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2), which covers government personnel changes without detailed portfolio information.
